note: Battles that are red because the defect they describe is open. A red listed here does not fail a build; a red that is not listed is a regression. Rewrite with `npm run battle:ci -- --accept`.
order: Repair in severity order: every S0, then every S1, then S2 and below. `bySeverity` is the count at each, and `knownRed` is sorted the same way, so the top of the list is the next work.
knownRed: [S0][EXP-001,DYN-004] an operand names one thing, at every door that reads it
[S0][VAL-002,SUB-002,COL-001] a row whose cells are disabled leaves the rows after it where they were
[S1][A11Y-004] a widget announcing a state only when it is in it is still reported
[S1][A11Y-004] a widget that always announces it is still caught
[S1][EXP-001] a guard claims only what the validator will take
[S1][PKG-001,REA-002] a second copy of the package does not turn the cross-runtime guard off
[S1][REA-001,REA-003] the conformance suite refuses a runtime that decides change differently
[S1][REA-002,API-001] a sink built from the published factories can be given to a form
[S2][ADP-001,DYN-001] an adapter that publishes a dynamic-form door reads the dynamic contract
[S2][ADP-001] an adapter that wraps every controller wraps every controller
[S2][DYN-001,DYN-003] every version one runtime accepts is one the others have a position on
